args.query: MATCH (p:Player)-[:WON]->(m:Match {round: 'F'})-[:PART_OF]->(t:Tournament {name: 'Wimbledon', year: 2019}) RETURN p.name AS winner, m.score AS score

claims.text: Novak Djokovic won the 2019 Wimbledon final, defeating his opponent 7‑6(5) 1‑6 7‑6(4) 4‑6 13‑12(3).
